decisions.reason: The illuminated candle arch line fits the core seasonal range and lets the firm refresh individual models rather than drop the whole line, though its absence from the website in 2020–2021 adds some uncertainty.
One-tier pyramids are a staple of Erzgebirge-style workshops and usually stay in the catalogue for many years, despite the lack of recent website visibility.
The electronic music box system is distant from the core craft and its Christmas platform was already withdrawn, but as the stated flagship it is likely kept a while longer.
This low-visibility accessory for a non-core electronic system has already lost a sibling product, so its resources are better spent on the traditional woodcraft business.
The Dresden-themed pyramid builds on established craftsmanship and serves a stable collector and regional gift market.
